nodes.description: mapping (address => Holder) public Acc storing each holder's unlockTime and balance
Log LogFile contract reference used to append history messages
uint public MinSum = 1 ether, minimum balance required before a Collect
Put(uint _unlockTime) public payable: credits msg.value to Acc[msg.sender] and sets the unlock time
Collect(uint _am) public payable: sends _am to msg.sender via low-level call then decrements the stored balance
unnamed payable fallback function that forwards to Put(0)
ALFA_bank(address log) constructor that assigns the Log contract reference
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as the Acc mapping key and as the external call target/refund receiver
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenced time used for the unlock time and the withdrawal gate
msg.sender.call.value(_am)(): unchecked low-level value transfer executed before the balance is decremented
acc.balance += msg.value: unchecked arithmetic credit of deposited ether
acc.balance -= _am: unchecked arithmetic debit executed after the external call
acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>now?_unlockTime:now: write whose value depends on block.timestamp
_unlockTime parameter of Put, user-supplied unlock timestamp
_am parameter of Collect, user-supplied withdrawal amount
log parameter of the ALFA_bank constructor, external Log contract address
local storage reference acc in Put aliasing Acc[msg.sender]
local storage reference acc in Collect aliasing Acc[msg.sender]
Message[] public History array of logged messages in the Log contract
Message LastMsg storage slot reused as the staging record before pushing to History
AddMessage(address _adr, uint _val, string _data) public: writes LastMsg fields and pushes it into History
_adr parameter of AddMessage, sender address to record
_val parameter of AddMessage, value to record
_data parameter of AddMessage, string payload to record

edges.reason: Put indexes Acc with msg.sender to locate the caller's holder record, making authorization caller-controlled
Collect indexes Acc with msg.sender to locate and authorize the caller's holder record
the low-level value call uses msg.sender as both target and recipient, handing control to the untrusted caller
Collect performs the external value transfer before updating acc.balance
the fallback function of the caller can re-enter Collect while the external call is in flight
acc.balance -= _am is only reached after the external call returns, so re-entrancy corrupts the accounting
Put credits msg.value into acc.balance with unchecked addition
Collect debits _am from acc.balance with unchecked subtraction after the call
block.timestamp (now) feeds the ternary that determines acc.unlockTime
Put writes acc.unlockTime from a value derived from block.timestamp
the Collect gate now > acc.unlockTime depends on miner-influenced block.timestamp
the payable fallback function forwards execution into Put(0)
the constructor stores the supplied Log contract address into LogFile
Put invokes LogFile.AddMessage to record the deposit
Collect invokes LogFile.AddMessage to record the withdrawal
LogFile is an external contract whose AddMessage function is invoked as an external call
the user-supplied _am amount is the value forwarded in the low-level external call
the user-supplied _am amount is subtracted from acc.balance
the user-supplied _unlockTime parameter flows into the acc.unlockTime write guarded by now
the constructor parameter log is assigned to the LogFile state variable
AddMessage writes the Sender, Val and Data fields of LastMsg
AddMessage pushes LastMsg into the public History array
AddMessage records block.timestamp (now) into LastMsg.Time
Collect compares acc.balance against the MinSum threshold state variable
the local acc reference in Put aliases the storage slot updated by acc.balance += msg.value
the local acc reference in Collect aliases the storage slot updated by acc.balance -= _am

normalization_plan.reason: _unlockTime is an argument of Put and is only used to compute acc.unlockTime
_am is an argument of Collect and only feeds the balance check and the external call value
log is the sole constructor argument and is immediately stored into LogFile
the local acc in Put is just a storage alias for Acc[msg.sender] used by the function body
the local acc in Collect is just a storage alias for Acc[msg.sender] used by the function body
_adr is an argument of AddMessage and is only stored into LastMsg.Sender
_val is an argument of AddMessage and is only stored into LastMsg.Val
_data is an argument of AddMessage and is only stored into LastMsg.Data
